en.html:
Silver Star left. I looked back down at the ground.

...The tsurugi huddled there was close to death.

Muramasa had become a terrible sight. Bent, twisted, distorted—as if falling from a mountain had not been enough, and the rocks had come down after her too.

That crimson armor, now it looked like bloodied flesh.

銀星号は去り、俺は視線を地上へ戻した。
　……瀕死の劒冑が<ruby>蹲<rt>うずくま</rt></ruby>っている。

　村正は、見るも無残な姿と化していた。
　歪み、<ruby>捩<rt>ねじ</rt></ruby>れ、曲がり――山峰から転落した上に落石
の雨を浴びればかくもなろうか。

　深紅の甲鉄が、今は血塗れの肉膚と目に映る。

en.html:
More than once I had considered it.

And every time, I had given it up. An ordinary tsurugi would be eaten by the Eggs. To fight Silver Star, there was nothing to do but keep using this cursed armor. That was how I had settled the matter.

No alternative, so use Muramasa.

Resignation only.

Wanting her—no. Never that.

それは一度ならず、考えた事ではある。

　そしていつも、断念してきたのだった。
　並の劒冑では〝卵〟に食われてしまうのだから仕方
がない。銀星号と戦うには、この呪わしい劒冑を使い
続ける以外にない――と。

　そう諦めて、村正を使ってきたのだ。

　<ruby>諦めて<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>。

　望んだのでは、決してなく。

en.html:
Muramasa.

For a tsurugi, too much feeling. Easily worked up, easily shaken. A strong will of her own; sometimes she disobeyed, sometimes she simply dug her heels in.

Just now she had even tried using her power against me.

And the Balance of Good and Evil. With this tsurugi, battle would always be made fruitless.

...That was Muramasa.

Two years on the same road.
My tsurugi.

村正。

　劒冑にしては感情的で、しばしば<ruby>昂<rt>たかぶ</rt></ruby>り、動揺する。
　自我も強く、時として指示に逆らい、<ruby>ごね<rt>・・</rt></ruby>たりする。

　先刻は、俺に対して力を<ruby>揮<rt>ふる</rt></ruby>おうとまでしかけた。

　そして善悪相殺の戒律。
　この劒冑は必ず、戦いを<ruby>無益<rt>・・</rt></ruby>なものにしてしまう。

　……それが村正。

　二年間、<ruby>道行<rt>みちゆき</rt></ruby>を共にしてきた、
　俺の劒冑だ。

Kageaki"Muramasa. You are right."

en.html:
Kageaki"All killing is the work of an evil demon."
Kageaki"There are no exceptions. There is no justice in any killing."
Kageaki"There is no justice in battle."
Muramasa《...Mido...》
Kageaki"Muramasa. You taught me that."
Kageaki"Suppose I had bonded with another tsurugi, fought these two years with it... By now, perhaps I would be calling myself a hero."
Kageaki"Righteous warrior, saving the people by fighting evil and cutting it down. Silver Star defeated, now Rokuhara also should be overthrown—perhaps I would be thinking like that..."
Kageaki"Thinking of it only makes me shudder. Self-righteousness with makeup on, call it justice, get drunk on it and start a war..."
Muramasa《............》
Kageaki"Muramasa. There is no justice in me."
Kageaki"That truth I never want to forget. That is why I need you."
Kageaki"Throw you away, take another tsurugi... then I am choosing that self-righteous road myself. Good people, spare them. Bad people, kill them."
Kageaki"Saying there are people who may die and people who must not, and I have the right to decide who belongs where..."
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"A shameless hero, I do not want to become. Worse, people see me, think there really is such a thing as righteous war, and start following. That ridiculous result I want even less."
Kageaki"That would be disaster itself."
Muramasa《Mido.》
Kageaki"I choose you."
Kageaki"I choose the law, the Balance of Good and Evil."
Kageaki"Will you choose me also?"
Muramasa《...》

There is no justice in any killing."Kageaki"There is no justice in battle."Muramasa《...Mido...》Kageaki"Muramasa. You taught me that."Kageaki"Suppose I had bonded with another tsurugi, fought these two years with it... By now, perhaps I would be calling myself a hero."Kageaki"Righteous warrior, saving the people by fighting evil and cutting it down. Silver Star defeated, now Rokuhara also should be overthrown—perhaps I would be thinking like that..."Kageaki"Thinking of it only makes me shudder. Self-righteousness with makeup on, call it justice, get drunk on it and start a war..."Muramasa《............》Kageaki"Muramasa. There is no justice in me."Kageaki"That truth I never want to forget. That is why I need you."Kageaki"Throw you away, take another tsurugi... then I am choosing that self-righteous road myself. Good people, spare them. Bad people, kill them."Kageaki"Saying there are people who may die and people who must not, and I have the right to decide who belongs where..."Muramasa《...》Kageaki"A shameless hero, I do not want to become. Worse, people see me, think there really is such a thing as righteous war, and start following. That ridiculous result I want even less."Kageaki"That would be disaster itself."Muramasa《Mido.》Kageaki"I choose you."Kageaki"I choose the law, the Balance of Good and Evil."Kageaki"Will you choose me also?"Muramasa《...》

ja.html:
景明「殺人はなべて悪鬼の所業」
景明「例外など無い。 　あらゆる殺人に正義は無い」
景明「戦いに正義は無い」
村正《……御堂……》
景明「村正。お前がそれを教えてくれた」
景明「お前ではなく、他の劒冑と結縁して、この 二年を戦っていたら…… 　俺は今頃、自分のことを英雄とでも思って いたかもしれん」
景明「世の人々を救うために悪と戦いこれを討つ、 正義の武者だとな。 　そうして、銀星号を倒した暁には、六波羅 をも打倒しようなどと考えていたか……」
景明「想像するだに怖気おぞけの走る話だ。 　独善の化粧でしかない正義に酔い、争乱を 引き起こすなど……」
村正《…………》
景明「村正。 　俺に正義は無い」
景明「その真実を決して忘れたくない。 　だからお前が必要だ」
景明「お前を捨てて別の劒冑を取れば…… 　善人は殺さず悪人は殺す・・・・・・・・・・・という独善の道を、 俺は選ぶことになる」
景明「世には死んで良い人間と死んではならない 人間とがいて、自分にはその区別をする権利 があるのだと認めることになる……」
村正《……》
景明「俺は厚顔無恥な英雄になどなりたくはない。 　世間の人々がそんな俺を見て、正義の戦い があると信じ、後に続こうとする――などと、 馬鹿げた始末になるのは尚のこと御免だ」
景明「それこそ災禍わざわいというものだ」
村正《御堂》
景明「俺はお前を選ぶ」
景明「善悪相殺の戒律を選ぶ」
景明「お前も、俺を選んではくれないか」
村正《……》

en.html:
Muramasa《Really... you are all right with this...?》
Kageaki"For me, it has to be you."
Muramasa《Mido... ...But...》
Muramasa《I... kept the Second Muramasa alive. My mother. Silver Star came into this age because of me... So—》
Kageaki"Alone you must fight, is it?"
Muramasa《...》
Kageaki"Exactly the same feeling I had. No, still I have it... but—"
Kageaki"Let us admit this much, Muramasa. Alone, you are weak. Alone, so am I."
Kageaki"Each needs the other. The two of us have to become one warrior, or we cannot fight."
Kageaki"Fight... with me."
Muramasa《...Mido...》

景明「一緒に……戦ってくれ」
村正《……御堂……》

en.html:
I bit the pad of my right thumb, shallowly breaking the skin. As blood welled up, I held it out to the tsurugi.

—This thumb, without it I could not properly wield a sword.

右手の親指に歯を立て、腹を浅く食い破る。
　血が溢れ始めたそれを、俺は劒冑へ向けた。

　――この指は、太刀を扱うに欠かせぬ指。

Hesitantly, the tsurugi answered with an outstretched limb.
It touched me.

Blood stained the armor.

en.html:
Once, a sound like a crystal bell passed between Muramasa and me.

This was————

The simplest, the oldest proper rite of a warrior: the Tatewaki Ceremony, the sword-bearing ceremony.

Here our bond was formed...
For the first time, Muramasa and I became one warrior.

This was————

The simplest, the oldest proper rite of a warrior: the Tatewaki Ceremony, the sword-bearing ceremony.

Here our bond was formed...
For the first time, Muramasa and I became one warrior.

ja.html:
水晶の鐘を打つような<ruby>楽<rt>がく</rt></ruby>が、一度。
　俺と村正の間を渡った。

　これが――――

　最も簡素で、最も古い、武者正調の<ruby>帯刀儀礼<rt>タテワキノギ</rt></ruby>。

　ここに<ruby>縁<rt>えにし</rt></ruby>は結ばれ……
　俺と村正は初めて、一騎の武者と<ruby>成<rt>な</rt></ruby>った。
